name: campaign_window_days
label_en: days the return of a campaign is read over (and the days before them, for a fall)
explain: two weeks smooth a week's rhythm and still move with a campaign
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_learning_days
label_en: days of delivery before a campaign leaves learning
label_zh: 活动离开学习期所需的投放天数
explain: platforms' own learning lasts about a week; too few conversions is unjudged, not slow
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_judge_spend_multiple
label_en: how many times the creative doubt line a campaign spends in the window before its return is read
label_zh: 判断活动前窗口内的花费倍数
explain: a few conversions at one creative's doubt line say little about a campaign
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_min_conversions
label_en: conversions a window needs before a cost per conversion is read
label_zh: 读取转化成本所需的最少转化数
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_earn_margin
label_en: how far above its kind's (else the account's) return a campaign is earning
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_use_share
label_en: the share of its budget a campaign spends for money to be its limit rather than its creatives
explain: under it the campaign cannot use more money: it needs more creatives
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_issue_share
unit: share of the last 7 days' spend
label_en: the share of spend on ads with issues that makes a campaign blocked
label_zh: 有问题广告占花费的比例
explain: a campaign mostly spent on ads the platform flags cannot be judged
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_budget_step
label_en: the size of one proposed budget change
label_zh: 每次建议调整预算的幅度
explain: at most a fifth a step, with a cooldown
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_end_idle_days
label_en: days without delivery after which a campaign is ended
label_zh: 多少天没有投放就算结束
explain: a fortnight without delivery is over
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_hold_weeks
label_en: how many weekly readings in a row must say a new state before a campaign changes between earning, steady, fatiguing and unjudged
label_zh: 连续几周的读数都指向新状态才换状态
explain: one week's noise must not flip a campaign
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_decline_drop
label_en: how much its return must fall against the window before for a campaign that is not above its benchmark to be declining
label_zh: 回报比前一窗口下降多少算下滑
explain: a quarter is a fall a week of noise rarely makes; a fall with no exposure evidence is not fatigue
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_good_pct
label_en: a campaign's weekly relative click-through rate counted as once good: the best 20% of its own history
label_zh: 曾经表现好:自身历史最好的 20%
explain: the peak is the mean of at least two such weeks
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_bad_pct
label_en: a campaign's weekly relative click-through rate counted as now bad: at or under the worst 20% of its own earlier history
label_zh: 现在表现差:自身历史最差的 20% 以内
explain: the owner's definition of fatigue: once good, now bad
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_ctr_drop
label_en: how far under its peak the relative click-through rate must be for the fall to count as fatigue
label_zh: 相对点击率低于峰值多少才算疲劳
explain: vendors put a creative's fatigue at a 15 to 20% click-through fall
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_min_weeks
label_en: how many weekly readings a campaign needs before its fatigue is judged
label_zh: 判断疲劳至少要几周的读数
explain: a peak and a low need a history; fewer weeks is no reading, never a guess
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_min_impressions
label_en: a week with fewer impressions than this is no reading for the fatigue rule
label_zh: 一周曝光少于此值就不算读数
explain: a click-through rate needs volume; thin weeks are pulled to 1 as well
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: campaign_fatigue_prior_impressions
label_en: the weight, in impressions, of the account's click-through rate when a campaign's own week is smoothed toward it
label_zh: 平滑时账户点击率的权重(曝光数)
explain: a Beta-Binomial smoothing with a prior of 1,000
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
